stem: The harvest work order was valid at startup, but a spill later creates an uncontrolled slip hazard. What controls the next action?
choices: Continue because the work order was valid when the shift began and authorization has already been established.
Wait for a supervisor to notice the spill before changing the work sequence.
Reassess the changed condition and apply the authorized spill/slip control or stop and escalate before continuing harvest movement.
Finish the current batch before cleanup so partially completed material does not sit in process.
rationale: Authorization at startup does not freeze conditions for the rest of the task. A new spill creates a changed hazard state that must be controlled before work continues. Technician I should use the permitted response or stop/escalate rather than allowing production priority to override a newly unsafe pathway.
